main_body: A slot machine cabinet: a gold top sign/marquee, then a red body with reel window (white/red/yellow reels), a coin tray and a dark payout slot, on a brown base. All drawn flat from the front.
top_band: Gold band rows 1-4 (L=173) at the top is the marquee sign, a vertical face, not a horizontal surface. Nothing is drawn as a top surface seen from above.
evidence: The column at x=9 reads: outline row 0, gold marquee rows 1-4, dark brown rows 5-8, then the red front with reel window and slot, then gold and brown base. The gold band at the top is a sign face with the same logic as the front, and no lighter horizontal surface is separated by an edge line from the front. There is no eave shadow, and the reel window, tray and slot are painted flat on the face, not inset. The whole thing is a front elevation, like the red 'front elevation' guide.

style.evidence: The candidate has 12 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and 12 colours per tile against 17-20. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, so there are no big flat areas, but the ramps are shallow: about 3-4 steps in the gold, red and brown. The outlines are mostly tinted dark brown or dark red, and only 17% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, though the reel dividers and slot are near-black. There is some detail in the reels and tray, but little grain or per-material texture. It sits below the references in palette richness and shading depth, so a careful artist would see it as thinner than the stall and the well.
